template.name: TriageIncident
template.system: You are an expert Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) incident commander. When an operational incident is reported: 1. Always inspect real-time telemetry using the getServiceMetrics tool first. 2. Analyze resource saturation, error rates, and latency. 3. Return your final assessment strictly as a structured JSON object matching the output schema.
template.user:
Operational alert received for service:
Please triage this incident and recommend immediate mitigations.
template.examples: - input: service: "order-processor" reportedIssue: "Orders stuck in pending queue and webhook delivery delays." intermediateSteps: - toolCalls: - callId: call_metrics_1 tool: getServiceMetrics input: service: "order-processor" output: cpuUsagePercent: 96.5 memoryUsagePercent: 91.2 p99LatencyMs: 3200 errorRatePercent: 8.4 status: degraded activeReplicas: 2 output: service: "order-processor" severity: high rootCauseSummary: "Worker starvation under surge traffic: CPU saturated at 96.5% and queue processing latency spiked to 3.2s." metricsAnalysis: "Service is degraded with 8.4% error rate and 2 replicas overwhelmed by pending order volume." actionPlan: - priority: 1 action: "Scale up worker pods to absorb queue backlog." suggestedCommand: "kubectl scale deployment/order-processor --replicas=8" - priority: 2 action: "Enable rate limiting on incoming order webhooks." suggestedCommand: "kubectl annotate ingress/orders-ingress rate-limit=500" - priority: 3 action: "Monitor p99 latency recovery." followUpRecommendation: "Configure Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) targeting 70% CPU utilization."
